channel.title: Sleep Club — Owners Inc. Sleep Stories (Members)
channel.description: Sleep Club is the members-only podcast feed from Owners Inc. Inside: a Premium Library of full sleep episodes appearing on a podcast feed for the first time, seamless All-Night soundscape cuts made to play all night, and every new Owners Inc. sleep episode 7 days before it reaches the free feed. These stories and soundscapes are made to help you wind down and drift off; they are not medical treatment. Narration disclosure: episodes are narrated by a high-quality AI voice from scripts written and edited for sleep, and are labeled as AI-narrated here and on our own channels. Soundscapes are synthesized in-house and contain no voice. Owners Inc. Everybody's doing it.

item.title: The Hinterkaifeck Mystery
item.description: A Sleep Mysteries episode, told slowly for sleep. In 1922, on a small farm in Bavaria, a family told neighbors that someone had been in their attic — footprints in the snow led to the house, and none led away. The whole story, gently and quietly, with nothing sudden and nothing to startle. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice (Placid River) from a script written and edited for sleep. Made to help you drift off.

item.title: The Story of the Moon
item.description: Settle in, and let the Moon keep you company. A calm, hour-long sleep episode telling the Moon's whole story slowly — its fiery birth, its dark seas and bright craters, its phases, tides, and soft eclipses, the quiet footprints people left in its dust, and the old stories told about it for thousands of years. Nothing here you need to remember; just listen, drift, and rest. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: The Deep, Quiet Ocean
item.description: A slow, calm descent through the ocean — from the warm, sunlit surface, down through the twilight zone and the midnight zone, into the abyss, ending at rest on the soft, quiet ocean floor, with marine snow falling gently the whole way down. Just quiet, darkness, and slowness, all the way to sleep. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: Saturn and Its Quiet Rings
item.description: A calm, hour-long sleep story about Saturn — its pale gold clouds and long, slow year, its rings followed particle by particle from ice grains to house-sized boulders, its quiet moons, and the Cassini spacecraft's long visit and gentle end. Closes with how to find Saturn's steady, untwinkling light in the night sky for yourself. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: Snowfall: The Quiet of Winter
item.description: A calm, slow sleep story about falling snow. How flakes form high in a cloud, why fresh snow hushes the world, a walk through a snowy pine forest, winter animals at rest, Wilson Bentley photographing snowflakes, and moonlight on a quiet field, settling toward sleep. Told slowly, with no sudden sounds. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: Great Rivers of the World
item.description: A slow, calm journey at dusk in a small boat down three great rivers — the Nile, the Amazon, and the Mississippi — ending at the sea. Unhurried water, quiet banks, and the long story of the rivers that carried the world. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: Dinosaurs and Deep Time
item.description: A slow, calm walk through prehistory for sleep: ancient seas with trilobites, the first forests and giant dragonflies, and the long age of dinosaurs — peaceful sauropod herds, duck-billed dinosaurs, a mother guarding her nest, feathers, colors, and footprints left in mud. The story closes softly, with life going on and birdsong in the morning. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: The Book of Ruth: A Quiet Story of Loyalty (KJV)
item.description: The Book of Ruth read slowly for sleep — the quiet story of loyalty, kindness, and a journey home, in the words of the King James Version, woven with gentle narration. This is the corrected render: every scripture sentence in it was checked word for word against the KJV text. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: Psalms for Sleep
item.description: A calm hour of gentle narration woven around beloved passages from the Psalms and other restful scriptures — the shepherd psalm, psalms of protection and stillness, words of rest from the Gospels, and the watcher psalm — read slowly to help you drift off. All scripture readings are from the King James Version. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: Genesis: In the Beginning
item.description: A quiet, slow reading of the creation account in Genesis chapters one and two, woven with gentle original narration for rest at the end of the day. All scripture readings are from the King James Version. First time on a podcast feed. Narrated by an AI voice from a script written and edited for sleep.

item.title: Rain All Night — Rain and Distant Thunder (8 Hours), Part 1 of 3
item.description: Eight hours of gentle rain and distant thunder, built to play all night. Because of file-size limits on our hosting, the All-Night cut arrives in three parts — add Part 1, Part 2, and Part 3 to your app's Up Next queue in order and they will play straight through the night. No voice, no bookends, nothing sudden. Synthesized in-house by Owners Inc.
